name: Antigravity Tab Group Guard
description: In-browser automation bridge & Chrome Tab Group isolation for Antigravity via Native Messaging and chrome.debugger. Zero network egress, zero modal prompts.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; connect-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none';
